explanation: Rep.ofHom_comp states that Rep.ofHom turns IntertwiningMap.comp into categorical composition. It holds by rfl because of the library's own definition of the Rep category. I searched Mathlib/RepresentationTheory for other ofHom lemmas and found only sibling lemmas about Rep (ofHom_id, ofHom_add and so on). The generic ConcreteCategory file has no ofHom_comp lemma, because ConcreteCategory has no general composition law on its hom type. I found no other declaration that states this.
